lines.text: Prices climb while my paycheck stays still
Every aisle feels steeper uphill
I do the math late at night in my head
And the numbers never land where I need them instead
Cut the extras, stretch the rest
Tell myself I’m doing my best
But the ground keeps shifting under my feet
I can’t keep up, I can’t keep up
Every time I catch my breath, the cost goes up
I can’t keep up, I can’t keep up
Working twice as hard and it’s never enough
Another month of thinner margins again
Trading wants for the things I can’t skip
I used to dream a little further ahead
Now I’m just trying not to slip
Cut the extras, stretch the rest
Tell myself I’m doing my best
But the ground keeps shifting under my feet
I can’t keep up, I can’t keep up
Every time I catch my breath, the cost goes up
I can’t keep up, I can’t keep up
Working twice as hard and it’s never enough
I’m not asking for easy
I’m just tired of the chase
Every dollar I make
Gets eaten by the same old place
I can’t keep up, I can’t keep up
Every time I catch my breath, the cost goes up
I can’t keep up, I can’t keep up
Working twice as hard and it’s never enough
